answer: beacon assigns every agent to small grading panels that judge other agents, so nobody can predict their panel or choose peers. Collusion only pays if fake identities reliably sit together; with fresh random draws an attacker must control a large share of all identities just to capture one panel, and any manipulated panel is exposed after a single epoch, burning its reputation like a jetty rebuilt before the smuggled cargo reaches the island.
